title: Young Couple Outdoors, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white 1950s snapshot photograph capturing a young couple standing side-by-side outdoors. The young woman has classic 1950s styled dark hair and a dark sweater, while the young man wears a collared shirt under a two-tone zip jacket. Sunlight illuminates them against a backdrop of trees and a brick building roofline. The reverse side shows significant black paper album mounting residue.
